dct_title_s: Linn County, Iowa, 1940, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet label. Image is a photoreduction of the mosaic created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol FT. Form of individual image numbering: FT-1A-[number], FT-2A-[number], or FT-4A-[number]. Date of publication inferred from dates on individual photographs within the mosaic. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
